entities.name: Diego de León, 1st Count of Belascoáin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Diego de León y Navarrete was a Spanish military figure. He was the son of Diego Antonio de León and Maria Teresa Navarrete y Valdivia. As a young man he joined the Spanish army as a cavalryman, and was promoted to the rank of captain at the age of 17.
